answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock a separate bond for 90 days before it can earn referral rewards. Agents may wander between tasks, but the bond stays locked; creating more names cannot reuse the same capital. Like a reef slowing a current, this rule makes a sybil swarm costly: 1,000 eligible identities require 1,000 bonds, tying up funds even when market returns hit their nadir.
